translator_notes: Traditional-sounding town song; origin unclear. 'За нунко ме канел' I read as 'invited me as godfather (best man)'; 'диското' is rendered 'my plate' following the given note's tray sense loosely, my reading.

words_to_learn.en: uncle, respectful address to an older man

lines.en: Last night I went, my dear, to the bazaar,
to the shop of Uncle Nikola.
- Hey, Uncle Nikola, my dear tinsmith,

lines.cyr: себап да чиниш, море, да не ме в'рниш.
lines.lat: sebap da činiš, more, da ne me v'rniš.
lines.en: do a good deed, hey, do not send me back.

lines.cyr: Сакај шо сакаш, арно ќе ти платам,
lines.lat: Sakaj šo sakaš, arno ḱe ti platam,
lines.en: Ask what you like, I will pay you well,

lines.cyr: сaл гледај саглaм да го калајдисаш.
lines.lat: sal gledaj saglam da go kalajdisaš.
lines.en: just take care to tin it soundly.
My blood brother, hey, my neighbor,

lines.cyr: за нунко ме канел в недела,
lines.lat: za nunko me kanel v nedela,
lines.en: has invited me for his godfather on Sunday,

lines.cyr: бакшиш ќе носам, а бре бај Николо,
lines.lat: bakšiš ḱe nosam, a bre baj Nikolo,
lines.en: I will bring a gift, hey Uncle Nikola,

lines.cyr: бакшиш ќе дадам, море на невестата.
lines.lat: bakšiš ḱe dadam, more na nevestata.
lines.en: I will give a gift, hey, to the bride.
